description.en: Planned fossil-form study featuring very long hinge wings extend beyond a short folded and ribbed central shell.
description.zh: 拟议化石形态研究：极长铰合翼越出短而褶肋明显的中央壳。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning study grounded in a named taxon source; reconstructed or simplified components remain artistic interpretations.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据具名分类单元来源进行属级规划；补全及简化结构仍属于复原或美术解释。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is very long hinge wings extend beyond a short folded and ribbed central shell; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以极长铰合翼越出短而褶肋明显的中央壳为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish very long hinge wings extend beyond a short folded and ribbed central shell in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以极长铰合翼越出短而褶肋明显的中央壳搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Named source supports the principal form. Species-level dimensions, missing structures and soft tissues still require a selected specimen reference.
reference_notes: Devonian Ohio winged-shell specimen. No exact coexistence is implied.

sources.title: Brachiopod collection
sources.supports: Mucrospirifer wing-like shell outline and Devonian Ohio specimen.
